download_bart_rag_turn_do_model: download the bart_rag_turn_do pre-trained model for hallucination detection to the given datapath
check_model_built_status: check if the bart_rag_turn_do model version v1.0 is already built in the datapath directory
get_model_directory: get the model directory path for the hallucination bart_rag_turn_do model using get_model_dir
download_models_archive: download the model.tgz archive file for the bart_rag_turn_do model using ParlAI download_models
review_download_function: review the download function to understand how the bart_rag_turn_do model is fetched and cached
